title: The Vapbag
description:
The Vapbag
The Vapbag is a neat little storage option, designed to store and carry your vapman along with various different accessories such as the filling, small herb container, sieve and extra mouthpieces.
This beautiful little bag is made from sustainable material which include cork and canvas.
Included
1 x The Vapbag
